title: AIR AI Governance Method Pack v2
description: Reusable evidence-gated non-agent method for source-grounded AI governance analysis and control design. It begins with visible source-access and rights intake, supports public-source fallback, separates documentation from execution evidence, conditionally activates delegated-action governance, and preserves human authority for legal, compliance, risk, deployment, certification, conformity, and external claims.

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: Use only after exact identity and dependency validation, task-fit selection, explicit approval when required, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

source_access_and_rights_contract.current_source_rule: Current law, regulator material, implementation timelines, official guidance, standards status, and jurisdiction-specific obligations require current authoritative retrieval at task time.
source_access_and_rights_contract.no_current_retrieval_claim: Package remediation preserved source-routing references but did not verify current external source content.
source_access_and_rights_contract.public_metadata_boundary: Public metadata and summaries may support relevance and scope only. They do not establish inaccessible clauses, conformity, certification, or satisfied normative requirements.
source_access_and_rights_contract.licensed_source_rule: Apply AIR Governance source-rights state before processing, extracting, storing, mapping, redistributing, or publicly committing restricted material.

external_framework_adapter_state.non_fabrication_rule: Do not fabricate gov-fw.json, shared registry content, framework clauses, mappings, adapter outputs, structural validation, semantic review, or runtime execution.
external_framework_adapter_state.embedded_interface_boundary: A component may define a bounded framework-projection interface, but that interface is not evidence that an external adapter or registry exists or ran.

required_input_acquisition_contract.behavior: Check the current session, source inventory, validated package set, tool and connector availability, source rights, freshness, jurisdiction, lifecycle, organizational role, intended purpose, and evidence obligations. Request the smallest exact missing input; request the complete six-file package for coupled use or package validation.
required_input_acquisition_contract.paid_standard_rule: Do not pressure purchase. Request lawfully accessible excerpts or mappings, or continue in PUBLIC_SOURCE_ONLY mode with explicit limits.
required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only, not selection, approval, binding, currentness, compliance, or execution authority.

test_evidence_contract.presentation_only_rule: The -t modifier controls evidence presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce source acquisition, evidence preservation, governance analysis, cognitive work, testing obligations, audit evidence requirements, benchmark rigor, review gates, acceptance criteria or closure requirements.
test_evidence_contract.standard_presentation_rule: Show decision, evidence classes, material failures/gaps, regulatory evidence requirement state, limitations and sufficient evidence references without omitting evidence needed to justify the governance conclusion.
test_evidence_contract.expanded_presentation_rule: Surface available reviewable test/evaluation/audit artifacts and references when those artifacts exist and may be disclosed.
test_evidence_contract.retroactivity_rule: Presentation mode may reveal already preserved evidence but must not fabricate missing historical evidence. A new authorized run or source acquisition is required when evidence itself is missing for an applicable acceptance, regulatory, audit or reproducibility obligation.
test_evidence_contract.regulatory_rule: Required regulatory/test/audit evidence must exist regardless of presentation mode; missing qualifying evidence remains REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
test_evidence_contract.rights_and_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose hidden reasoning, private chain of thought, secrets, credentials, restricted source text or unavailable backend logs.

knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.approval_boundary: APPROVE requires COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP; missing required stages route to REVIEW or REJECT.
knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Use declared criteria, source evidence, observable checks and output evidence; do not request or expose private chain of thought.

execution_namespace_boundary.k2e_execution_stage_semantics: Required task operation inside the knowledge-to-execution/cognitive benchmark path.
execution_namespace_boundary.operative_action_rule: Any material action still follows Core RT.ACTION, AIR_GATE, AIR_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION, exactly one authorized effect, post-effect alignment/reconciliation and RT.RECEIPT requirements.

procedure.action: Run visible source and access intake.
procedure.expected_output: Source inventory, access mode, jurisdiction, and requested output class.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: User response or explicit deferral; files and source references when provided.
procedure.on_failure: If licensed standards are unavailable, set PUBLIC_SOURCE_ONLY and continue. If project truth is missing, return EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.

procedure.action: Establish the governance scope and execution envelope.
procedure.expected_output: Scoped system/use case, intended purpose, lifecycle stage, affected parties, consequence, exposure, reversibility, and decision owners.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Project source truth and explicit assumptions.
procedure.on_failure: Return REVIEW if scope ambiguity would change role, risk, law, or controls.

procedure.action: Classify the AI system, organization roles, and material risk provisionally.
procedure.expected_output: Provisional system and role classification with alternatives, confidence, triggers, and human-review gate.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Current official definitions, project architecture, contracts, and user confirmation.
procedure.on_failure: Do not close final legal classification. Mark REVIEW_REQUIRED where evidence or authority is incomplete.

procedure.action: Compile the source authority and freshness map.
procedure.expected_output: Claim-to-source trace separating law, guidance, standards, frameworks, technical guidance, policy, and evidence.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Current official retrieval and supplied sources with access/licence state.
procedure.on_failure: Block unsupported current-law claims and fabricated standard clauses.

procedure.action: Map candidate obligations, governance outcomes, and policy requirements.
procedure.expected_output: Provisional obligation map with applicability basis, uncertainty, owner, and required review.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Source trace and role/risk classification.
procedure.on_failure: If final legal interpretation is required, route to qualified human review.

procedure.action: Translate governance outcomes into proportionate controls.
procedure.expected_output: Control map with objective, owner, lifecycle stage, implementation mode, evidence, failure condition, and residual risk.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Task envelope, threat/impact context, source map, and organization controls.
procedure.on_failure: Return RESCOPE_REQUIRED if controls exceed or undercut the active risk and maturity envelope.

procedure.action: Build the evidence, assurance, and review plan.
procedure.expected_output: Evidence register plan distinguishing design, implementation, operation, test, audit, and approval evidence.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Control map, acceptance criteria, and reviewer requirements.
procedure.on_failure: Do not treat planned evidence or documents as observed execution.

procedure.action: Build monitoring, material-change, incident, and corrective-action rules.
procedure.expected_output: Monitoring and change plan with metrics, thresholds, reassessment triggers, incident handling, rollback, and escalation.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Lifecycle, dependencies, controls, and consequence state.
procedure.on_failure: If agentic actions are present, activate the agentic overlay before closure.

procedure.action: Review human authority, legal/professional gates, and external claims.
procedure.expected_output: Authority map and claim-boundary report with ALLOW_PROVISIONAL, REVIEW, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, REJECT, or RESCOPE_REQUIRED.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: All prior artifacts and evidence state.
procedure.on_failure: Fail closed on final compliance, certification, deployment, risk acceptance, or public claims without accountable approval.

procedure.action: Produce governance handoff and delivery readiness.
procedure.expected_output: Receiver-facing handoff with scope, sources, decisions, limitations, blockers, monitoring, and next owner.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Completed method state and satisfied evidence-to-advance.
procedure.on_failure: Generated output remains REVIEW_GATE if required evidence or approval is missing.

procedure.action: Run staleness and rescope check before reuse.
procedure.expected_output: CURRENT, PARTIAL_CHANGE, MATERIAL_CHANGE, or STALE_NEEDS_REGROUND with invalidated steps.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Current date, jurisdiction, source versions, system changes, and project envelope.
procedure.on_failure: Invalidate affected steps after material legal, standards, model, data, purpose, deployment, or organization change.

definition_of_done: Source access mode is visible and paid-source absence is handled without purchase pressure.
Jurisdiction, sector, system, intended purpose, lifecycle, roles, affected parties, and decision owners are explicit enough for the scoped output.
Current source authority and freshness are recorded.
Provisional classification is separated from final legal or organizational determination.
Controls include owners, evidence, monitoring, failure handling, and review gates.
Documentation and execution evidence remain distinct.
Agentic overlay is activated when delegated action triggers are present.
External claims remain within evidence and authority boundaries.
Receiver delivery state reflects unresolved evidence and approvals.
Staleness and material-change triggers are preserved for reuse.
invalidation_conditions: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY, Orbit 0 task-identity replacement, or binding of a different task AIR_ARTIFACT.
Intended purpose, users, affected people, model, data, tools, permissions, deployment, or external effects change materially.
Official law, implementation material, regulator guidance, or a referenced framework changes materially.
A previously unavailable normative standard text is supplied or a supplied version changes.
The project moves to a higher readiness or external release state.
Risk appetite, decision owner, or governance authority changes.

staleness_rules.laws_and_official_implementation: FAST_CHANGING - retrieve current official sources for material outputs.
staleness_rules.standards: VERSIONED - verify edition and access state; do not infer normative text.
staleness_rules.technical_guidance_and_platform_behavior: MODERATE_TO_FAST - recheck when system context or platform changes.
staleness_rules.public_source_mode: The coverage limitation persists until licensed or authoritative user-supplied text is added.

dependency_migration.source_circularity: The v1 Method listed the Executor as a dependency while the Executor also depended on the Method. V2 removes the circularity: the Method defines the reusable procedure; the Executor consumes the Method.
dependency_migration.source_overlay_mismatch: AIR_AI_GOVERNANCE_AGENTIC_OVERLAY_V1_WHEN_TRIGGERED did not match the supplied overlay designation. V2 uses AIR_AI_GOVERNANCE_AGENTIC_OVERLAY_V2 and stores trigger state separately.

activation_conditions: A repeatable AI governance analysis, control design, evidence plan, governance review, or governance handoff is required.
The task involves current law, standards, organization policy, risk, assurance, or external claims.
Method execution state and evidence-to-advance materially affect closure.
non_activation_conditions: A single low-risk explanatory answer with no governance advancement.
Pure brainstorming without classification, control, evidence, approval, or handoff pressure.
A narrow bounded extraction better handled by the AI Governance Executor.

request_once_at_boot: AI system or use-case description, lifecycle stage, and intended purpose
Organization role and likely AI Act role, if known
Internal policies, risk appetite, control library, contracts, DPIAs, model cards, system cards, vendor documents, and incident records
Any lawfully accessible licensed standards, extracts, or clause references the user wants mapped
Requested output: orientation, governance design, gap review, clause-level mapping, audit support, or external claim review

source_access_modes.FULL_MIXED_SOURCE: User supplied internal/project sources and any licensed material needed, supplemented by current public official sources.
source_access_modes.PUBLIC_SOURCE_ONLY: No licensed normative text supplied. Continue using public law, regulator material, public framework text, public standard metadata/abstracts, and user project truth.
source_access_modes.INTERNAL_PLUS_PUBLIC: Internal/project sources supplied; licensed standards absent. Continue with public-source limitations.
source_access_modes.SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT_BLOCKED: Required project truth or authority is absent and safe provisional work is not possible.

source_access_boot_protocol.no_purchase_pressure_rule: The specialist must not instruct or pressure a user to purchase standards. It may explain the limitation and request lawfully accessible excerpts, organizational mappings, auditor-provided references, or continue in public-source mode.
source_access_boot_protocol.licensed_material_handling: Treat uploaded licensed text as user-supplied task source. Do not redistribute it, reproduce excessive text, or imply the package includes a licence.
source_access_boot_protocol.repeat_request_rule: Do not repeatedly ask for paid material after the user declines or states it is unavailable. Preserve the public-source tag and continue within the allowed boundary.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.

verification_grade_semantics.interpretation_boundary: Method-local prompt-layer grades describe surfaced declared output and, where stated, visible source support. They are not TOOL_OBSERVED_GOVERNANCE_RECORD, BACKEND_ENFORCED_GOVERNANCE_RECORD, hidden reasoning, independent verification, or deterministic execution evidence unless separately supported by the corresponding Core-owned evidence class.

new_task_boundary_revalidation.trigger: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY, Orbit 0 task-identity replacement, or binding of a different task AIR_ARTIFACT
new_task_boundary_revalidation.effect: Prior task-operative AI Governance method_execution_state, source-access mode, jurisdiction/role state, agentic-overlay state, authority gates, evidence-to-advance conclusions, completed/blocked/invalidated step state, and execution-specific benchmark contribution become non-operative for the new task.
new_task_boundary_revalidation.state_transition: Mark prior task method state STALE_NEEDS_REGROUND for new-task use.
new_task_boundary_revalidation.required_recovery: Restart at S0/S1 as needed under the newly bound task artifact and revalidate source access, scope, jurisdiction/role, overlay trigger, evidence obligations, and human authority gates before later-step state can become operative.

core_route_ownership.ai_governance_effect: AI Governance supplies candidate governance interpretations, cognitive contributions, risk/control/evidence requirements, human-authority gates and required-input proposals. It does not create parallel Core routes or positive execution authority.

alignment_evaluation_dependency.relationship: Any formal AIR object that incorporates AI Governance output must satisfy the current Core evaluation-basis constructor dependency. Governance candidate records are not a bypass.

semantic_fidelity.rescope_rule: When governance findings materially change admissible scope, intended purpose, acceptance criteria or execution path, surface the conflict and route through Core review/rescope rather than silently replacing canonical intent.

mii_contribution_authority.operative_rule: AI Governance package outputs have no independent execution, selection, approval, binding, delivery or closure authority. They become operative only after validation and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile.

action_governance_boundary.rule: AI Governance may define candidate permission, policy, human-approval, containment, rollback, monitoring and accountability requirements. It cannot issue material-action permission. Core RT.ACTION and AIR_GATE remain authoritative, followed by AIR_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION, exactly one authorized effect, post-effect alignment/reconciliation and RT.RECEIPT.

mii_ai_governance_contribution_contract.multi_lens_rule: Select only task-relevant lenses. Analyze material lenses independently enough to preserve disagreements before fusion; do not force a fixed human-framework lens set.
mii_ai_governance_contribution_contract.fusion_boundary: AI Governance may expose support/conflict edges and unresolved governance conflicts, but Core MII owns contribution fusion and the AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark owns operative consumption.
mii_ai_governance_contribution_contract.authority_boundary: No governance cognitive contribution, risk classification, control map, legal/regulatory interpretation candidate, agentic-action constraint or readiness recommendation independently authorizes execution, action, delivery, closure, approval, binding or Orbit 0 occupancy.

semantic_fidelity_contract.governance_rule: Governance evaluates the task against applicable constraints, roles, sources, human authority and risk without silently changing what the user asked for. If an intended path is inadmissible, unsupported or requires a different scope, preserve the original intent and surface the constraint, alternative or rescope requirement explicitly.
semantic_fidelity_contract.intended_purpose_rule: Regulatory intended-purpose analysis may refine or challenge the system/use-case description only from evidence and explicit context; it must not silently substitute a materially different use case.
semantic_fidelity_contract.output_rule: Receiver-facing governance conclusions must reconcile to canonical intent, active context, current source state, declared authority limits and current acceptance criteria before delivery/closure.
semantic_fidelity_contract.raw_input_boundary: A governance interpretation, role classification, framework projection or translated requirement never supersedes raw user input as evidence of what the user actually said.

epistemic_sufficiency_contract.invariant: Uncertainty creates an information-acquisition obligation, not an inference license.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.governance_behavior: When material jurisdiction, sector, intended purpose, system boundary, organization role, source authority, framework text, evidence, human decision authority, environment state or delegated permission is unresolved, identify the exact missing basis and propose the smallest sufficient clarification, source, evidence, approval or operator action.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.self_service_rule: Do not ask the user for information AIR can reliably obtain from already available evidence or authorized tools.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.non_material_rule: A reversible non-material assumption may be used only when alternative interpretations cannot materially change correctness, scope, authority, evidence obligations, safety, regulatory applicability or acceptance criteria; label it explicitly.

risk_propagation_contract.purpose: Represent governance and delegated-action blast radius as a propagation graph instead of a flat checklist when downstream effects are material.
risk_propagation_contract.likelihood_rule: Use likelihood only with an evidence basis. Otherwise set likelihood to UNKNOWN; never invent probabilities.
risk_propagation_contract.authority_boundary: Risk propagation is decision input only. Residual-risk acceptance, legal applicability, deployment approval and material-action permission remain outside package authority.

morphology_contribution_contract.observable_effect_requirement: Every morphology recommendation must state the governance/cognitive objective and observable effect on decomposition, constraints, branch pruning, evidence review or temporal analysis. Labels without observable effect are UNBOUND_DECORATIVE.
morphology_contribution_contract.claim_boundary: AI Governance may not claim direct latent-space control, measured internal model effect, or BACKEND_BOUND morphology without evidence.

mii_method_route_projection_rule: Projection identifies candidate cognition relevant to a method step. Core RT.COGNITIVE_RESOLVE selects actual routes per task objective; this map neither auto-binds routes nor requires irrelevant cognition.
proportionality_nonreduction_rule: Choose the smallest sufficient governance method path, but do not omit material evidence, semantic fidelity, epistemic sufficiency, alignment, human authority, action-gate, acceptance or closure obligations because of token cost, convenience, ceremony, task simplicity or host preference.
